### workspace run-and-report --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace run-and-report '<command>'

Run a shell command as a subprocess (bypassing tmux).
Captures stdout, stderr, and exit status, writes them under a UUID,
prints the JSON result, and exits with the command's exit code.

Examples:
  workspace run-and-report 'echo hello'    # run a command and capture its output
  workspace run-and-report 'rake spec'    # check the exit code in a script via $?
  workspace run-and-report 'bundle exec rspec' | jq '.status'    # parse the JSON result
  workspace run-and-report 'rake spec' | jq -r '.stderr'    # read only what the command wrote to stderr
  workspace run-and-report 'exit 3'    # a failing command: the JSON says status 3 and workspace exits 3
--- stderr
--- end
